clickhouse.q01:
SELECT publication_year, work_type, is_oa, is_xpac, count() AS works
FROM openalex_small_b.works
GROUP BY publication_year, work_type, is_oa, is_xpac
ORDER BY publication_year, work_type, is_oa, is_xpac;
clickhouse.q02:
SELECT
    w.publication_year,
    t.topic_id,
    t.display_name,
    countDistinct(w.work_id) AS works,
    sum(w.cited_by_count) AS citations
FROM openalex_small_b.works AS w
INNER JOIN openalex_small_b.work_topic AS wt ON w.work_id = wt.work_id
INNER JOIN openalex_small_b.topics AS t ON wt.topic_id = t.topic_id
GROUP BY w.publication_year, t.topic_id, t.display_name
ORDER BY w.publication_year, works DESC;
clickhouse.q03:
SELECT
    a.author_id,
    a.display_name,
    countDistinct(wa.work_id) AS works,
    sum(w.cited_by_count) AS citations
FROM openalex_small_b.work_author AS wa
INNER JOIN openalex_small_b.authors AS a ON wa.author_id = a.author_id
INNER JOIN openalex_small_b.works AS w ON wa.work_id = w.work_id
GROUP BY a.author_id, a.display_name
ORDER BY works DESC, a.author_id
LIMIT 1000;
clickhouse.q04:
WITH work_country AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT wi.work_id, i.country_code
    FROM openalex_small_b.work_institution AS wi
    INNER JOIN openalex_small_b.institutions AS i
        ON wi.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE i.country_code IS NOT NULL AND i.country_code != ''
)
SELECT
    w.publication_year,
    a.country_code AS country_a,
    b.country_code AS country_b,
    countDistinct(a.work_id) AS collaborative_works
FROM work_country AS a
INNER JOIN work_country AS b
    ON a.work_id = b.work_id AND a.country_code < b.country_code
INNER JOIN openalex_small_b.works AS w ON a.work_id = w.work_id
GROUP BY w.publication_year, country_a, country_b
ORDER BY w.publication_year, collaborative_works DESC;
clickhouse.q05:
SELECT 'outgoing' AS direction, cited_work_id AS neighbour_work_id
FROM openalex_small_b.citation_edge
WHERE citing_work_id = 8295370
UNION ALL
SELECT 'incoming' AS direction, citing_work_id AS neighbour_work_id
FROM openalex_small_b.citation_edge
WHERE cited_work_id = 8295370;
clickhouse.q06:
SELECT countDistinct(second.cited_work_id) AS second_hop_works
FROM openalex_small_b.citation_edge AS first
INNER JOIN openalex_small_b.citation_edge AS second
    ON first.cited_work_id = second.citing_work_id
WHERE first.citing_work_id = 8295370;
clickhouse.q07:
SELECT
    citing_year,
    cited_work_id,
    count() AS citations
FROM openalex_small_b.citation_edge
GROUP BY citing_year, cited_work_id
ORDER BY citations DESC, cited_work_id, citing_year NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1000;

athena.q01:
SELECT publication_year, work_type, is_oa, is_xpac,
            count(*) AS works FROM works
            GROUP BY publication_year, work_type, is_oa, is_xpac
athena.q02:
SELECT w.publication_year, t.topic_id, t.display_name,
            count(DISTINCT w.work_id) AS works,
            sum(w.cited_by_count) AS citations
            FROM works w JOIN work_topic wt ON w.work_id=wt.work_id
            JOIN topics t ON wt.topic_id=t.topic_id
            GROUP BY w.publication_year, t.topic_id, t.display_name
athena.q03:
SELECT a.author_id, a.display_name,
            count(DISTINCT wa.work_id) AS works,
            sum(w.cited_by_count) AS citations
            FROM work_author wa JOIN authors a ON wa.author_id=a.author_id
            JOIN works w ON wa.work_id=w.work_id
            GROUP BY a.author_id, a.display_name
            ORDER BY works DESC, a.author_id LIMIT 1000
athena.q04:
WITH work_country AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT wi.work_id, i.country_code
            FROM work_institution wi JOIN institutions i
            ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id
            WHERE i.country_code IS NOT NULL AND i.country_code != '')
            SELECT w.publication_year, a.country_code AS country_a,
            b.country_code AS country_b,
            count(DISTINCT a.work_id) AS collaborative_works
            FROM work_country a JOIN work_country b ON a.work_id=b.work_id
            AND a.country_code < b.country_code
            JOIN works w ON a.work_id=w.work_id
            GROUP BY w.publication_year, a.country_code, b.country_code
athena.q05:
SELECT 'outgoing' AS direction, cited_work_id AS neighbour_work_id
            FROM citation_edge WHERE citing_work_id=8295370
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'incoming' AS direction, citing_work_id AS neighbour_work_id
            FROM citation_edge WHERE cited_work_id=8295370
athena.q06:
SELECT count(DISTINCT b.cited_work_id) AS second_hop_works
            FROM citation_edge a JOIN citation_edge b
            ON a.cited_work_id=b.citing_work_id WHERE a.citing_work_id=8295370
athena.q07:
SELECT citing_year, cited_work_id, count(*) AS citations
            FROM citation_edge GROUP BY citing_year, cited_work_id
            ORDER BY citations DESC, cited_work_id, citing_year NULLS LAST LIMIT 1000

athena_normalization_views.works:
SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS work_id, CASE WHEN w.publication_year BETWEEN 0 AND 65535 THEN w.publication_year END AS publication_year,
            w.type AS work_type, coalesce(w.open_access.is_oa, false) AS is_oa,
            coalesce(w.is_xpac, false) AS is_xpac,
            cast(w.cited_by_count AS bigint) AS cited_by_count
            FROM raw_works w WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
athena_normalization_views.authors:
SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS author_id,
            max(a.author.display_name) AS display_name
            FROM raw_works w CROSS JOIN UNNEST(w.authorships) AS u(a)
            WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint)
athena_normalization_views.work_author:
SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS work_id, try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS author_id
            FROM raw_works w CROSS JOIN UNNEST(w.authorships) AS u(a)
            WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
athena_normalization_views.work_institution:
SELECT DISTINCT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS work_id,
            try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS author_id, try_cast(regexp_extract(i.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS institution_id
            FROM raw_works w CROSS JOIN UNNEST(w.authorships) AS u(a)
            CROSS JOIN UNNEST(a.institutions) AS v(i)
            WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            AND try_cast(regexp_extract(i.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
athena_normalization_views.institutions:
SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS institution_id,
            nullif(country_code, '') AS country_code
            FROM raw_institutions WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
athena_normalization_views.topics:
SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS topic_id, display_name
            FROM raw_topics WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            AND try_cast(regexp_extract(subfield.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            AND try_cast(regexp_extract(field.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            AND try_cast(regexp_extract(domain.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
athena_normalization_views.work_topic:
SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS work_id, try_cast(regexp_extract(t.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS topic_id
            FROM raw_works w CROSS JOIN UNNEST(w.topics) AS u(t)
            WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(t.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            AND t.score IS NOT NULL
athena_normalization_views.citation_edge:
SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS citing_work_id,
            try_cast(regexp_extract(ref, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS cited_work_id, min(CASE WHEN w.publication_year BETWEEN 0 AND 65535 THEN w.publication_year END) AS citing_year
            FROM raw_works w CROSS JOIN UNNEST(w.referenced_works) AS u(ref)
            WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(ref, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint), try_cast(regexp_extract(ref, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint)
